items.title: Theorem 5.3.15 (preprint 5.22): general position and Morse-type critical points of $t$

book.label: §5.3, Theorem 5.3.15 (preprint 5.22), p. 223 (preprint p. 181) (proof pp. 223–228 (preprint pp. 181–186))

items.title: The $L^p$ and Sobolev remark after Theorem 5.5.5: $W^{k,p}$ norms, bumps, $W^{1,4}$ and $W^{1,3/2}$

book.label: §5.5 (preprint §5.4.2), pp. 230–231 (preprint pp. 193–194)
book.statement: The usual norms of $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ have the differentiability of $\|\cdot\|_{L^p}$; $\beta(\|x\|^p)$ is a bump function of $L^p$; $W^{1,4}(\Omega)$ with $E_m = W^{1+m,4}(\Omega)$ admits sc-smooth bump functions, while for $W^{1,3/2}(\Omega)$ the straightforward one is only sc¹ — "does there exist a sc-smooth bump function on $E$?"

lean.statement: $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$, $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb R^n$, $p \ge 1$ (`SobolevRemark.Wsub`): the closed subspace of the $\ell^p$-product $\prod_{|\alpha| \le k}L^p(\Omega)$ cut out by the weak-derivative identities; a Banach space with $\|u\|^p = \sum\|D^\alpha u\|^p_{L^p}$ (`norm_rpow_W`), weak derivatives unique on open $\Omega$ (`Dop_zero_injective`). (1) Its norm has the differentiability of Theorem 5.5.5 (`remark_5_5_5_sobolev`). (2) $\beta(\|x\|^p)$ is a bump of $L^p$ and of $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ in the three cases (`hasContDiffBump_Lp`, `remark_5_5_5_sobolev_bump`). (3) Every sc-Banach space with $E_0 \cong W^{1,4}(\Omega)$ admits sc-smooth bump functions, and so do its local models and M-polyfolds modelled on it (`remark_5_5_5_W14`), through `LocalModel.hasBumpProperty_of_hasContDiffBump`. (4) On $W^{1,3/2}(\Omega)$ the bump $\beta(\|x\|^{3/2})$ is sc¹ (`remark_5_5_5_W1_3_2`). The sc-structure $E_m = W^{1+m,p}(\Omega)$ is `sobolevSc`, which takes the compactness of the inclusions (`hc`) and the density of $E_\infty$ (`hd`) as hypotheses; they are discharged for $\Omega = (0,1) \subset \mathbb R^1$ and every $p > 1$ (`SobolevCube.cubeSc`: Rellich `isCompactOperator_inclW_cube` through the compact Volterra operator, density `dense_smoothLvl_cube`), where `remark_5_5_5_W14_cube`, `remark_5_5_5_W14_instance` and `remark_5_5_5_W1_3_2_cube` give the claims on the text's sc-structure; `sobolevSc_hyps_empty` is the trivial instance $\Omega = \emptyset$.
